thread:
marc: heads up — running the embed sampleapp CLI against the new node sdk and I'm seeing a weird mix: our local batch helper sends 3 items, server returns 3 embeddings but second vector has 1537 dims while the other two are 1536.
anya: ouch. which SDK + cli versions?
marc: sampleapp v0.3.2, node-sdk v0.9.2. curl against the HTTP API returns all 1536s though. suspecting the client wrapper. minimal repro below.
sam: can you paste the request/response?
marc: sure — request we send (node helper):
```js
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'openembed-1536',
  input: ['a','b','c'],
  batch_size: 3
});
```
response excerpt (trimmed):
```json
{
  "data": [
    {"embedding": [0.1, 0.2, ... , 1536 entries]},
    {"embedding": [0.3, 0.4, ... , 1537 entries]},
    {"embedding": [0.6, 0.7, ... , 1536 entries]}
  ]
}
```
marc: when I run the same inputs through curl to the same hosted endpoint I get 1536 for all three.
olivia: is anything mutating the buffer in the batch helper? did we recently change float32 vs float16 packing?
marc: good call — the helper concatenates TypedArrays then slices by offsets. suspect off-by-one length calc when auth refresh interleaves.
anya: auth refresh?
marc: yeah — repro log shows one request got a 401 mid-stream, the SDK auth interceptor does a token refresh and replays the batch. but it replays the second chunk with an extra padding byte; the backend accepts it but we end up with a longer vector for that item. logs: 
```
[12:02:15] sending batch 0 id=rid_123 len=3
[12:02:15] server 401 token expired
[12:02:15] sdk auth refresh -> got new token
[12:02:15] replaying batch rid_123 (requeued)
[12:02:16] server 200 OK
```
sam: so replay duplicate is fine but why padding? maybe the replay path reuses a buffer and does a push instead of reset.
olivia: i can reproduce locally with node-launcher + mocked 401. repro steps?
marc: 1) set short token TTL 2) run sampleapp batch helper with 3 small items 3) trigger an auth callback that returns 401 for first attempt.
anya: thanks — i'll add a unit test for buffer reuse in batcher and check the splice/offset calculation.
sam: temp mitigation: add server-side dedupe by request id and validate embedding length per model. we already have model dim metadata. reject if mismatch.
marc: created ticket INF-2217 to track buffer-reuse fix + SDK patch v0.9.3, and a backend reject rule as safety net.
ci-bot: created issue INF-2217 and linked to pipeline #824.
olivia: also flagged as customer-impacting? any customer reports?
marc: only internal QA so far. happened in sampleapp onboarding flow which could confuse new users — high DX friction.
anya: ok plan: 1) quick server-side dim check + reject 2) unit test + fix SDK buffer reuse 3) release patch v0.9.3 4) update sampleapp and docs note about idempotency header (x-rdw-request-id) to prevent duplicate semantics.
sam: sg. thanks for the clear repro.
marc: one more gotcha I found — rerank/embedding pairing for reranker expects stable ordering, so duplicated/replayed batches can shift ranks. please add a note in the rerank helper about using request ids.
anya: will do. assigning reviewers: @sam @olivia.
marc: cheers :thumbsup:
